Name: Portable Home Theater Furniture Redux for 1.6
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Portable Home Theater Furniture Redux for 1.6[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][size=4]With permission from [b]dollynhoevida[/b] this mod has been resurrected![/size] [size=4]Check out the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19170]Here[/url][/size][/left]

[size=4]Bring the Stardew Valley movie theater home with a collection of portable theater furniture for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/size]

[size=4]Choose from Stardew Valley's movies and play them on your own theater screen. Once selected, the movie continuously loops until you choose another one.[/size]
[heading]Features[/heading]
[size=4]-Functional wired and wireless projectors[/size]
[size=4]
-Choose which movie you want to play[/size]
[size=4]
-Includes the vanilla Stardew Valley movies[/size]
[size=4]
-Movies loop continuously until changed[/size]
[size=4]
-Portable theater screens and decorations[/size]
[size=4]
-Furniture can be placed wherever normal furniture is allowed[/size]

[size=4][b]-Future updates incoming for multiplayer support[/b][/size]

[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[size=4]SMAPI[/size]
[size=4]Content Patcher[/size]
[size=4]Furniture Framework[/size]
[size=4]Calcifer[/size]
[size=4]Buttons Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS)[/size]

[size=4]Make sure all required frameworks are installed and up to date.[/size]
[heading]How to Use[/heading]
[size=4]Place a projector and theater screen.
Interact with the projector to open the movie selection menu, choose a movie, and the connected theater furniture will update to display your selection.
Interact with the projector again whenever you want to change movies.[/size]
